BIN RULE: every dual-support column is assigned to EXACTLY ONE bin — the named slot cell whose CENTRE is nearest the column's centre (ties broken by name order), over BL/BR/TL/TR (i,j), i,j < 3. So the bin weights PARTITION the support's total dual weight; they do not double count. The separate 'met' counts below are the geometric

statement (a column can overlap several cells) and are A113's singly/doubly-met census, not a partition. The conditioned square is NOT a dual-support column — the node LP counts only the budget = 11 - #cores OTHER squares — so no bin contains it; a bin a conditioned box can itself reach is marked (H).
lane count (A118): BL(0,0) LANE<=1 (n_cond_pot 2); BR(0,0) UNDECIDED; TR(0,0) UNDECIDED (n_cond_pot 2); TL(0,0) LANE>=2 [A118's stored record agrees]

CANDIDATE COVER — two-meeter (A118 T4): A118's lane count certifies that at most 1 square OTHER than the conditioned one can meet BL(0,0), while 2 conditioned square(s) could. Cover: (a) the conditioned square meets BL(0,0) -- restrict its box to the sub-box of poses that meet BL(0,0) and re-solve; (b) it does not
-- then BL(0,0) is met by at most one square in total and K0-FREE teleports the configuration into class k1, which is dead on the window.

what it needs to be a certified leaf: (a) the LANE <= 1 cover certified by interval arithmetic over the box cover (A118 has it: cover ok + confirm clean); (b) the 'meets C' / 'misses C' split emitted as two children with LP certificates; (c) K0-FREE for the k0 root (docs/proofs/k0_route.md, already proved).
